findings.claim: Nested spawn intake can persist a prepared child without a normal dispatcher starting it.
findings.reproduction: POST /api/swarms/spawns returns a prepared/requested receipt; code path does not invoke executeWorker. Existing test reaches child execution through direct service invocation.
findings.impact: Accepted/prepared work may not progress via ordinary intake; success must not be inferred from a prepared receipt.
findings.resolution: Open; dispatcher/admission policy needs a separately authorized and bounded design.
findings.verification: S1 INCONCLUSIVE; normal end-to-end dispatch not exercised.

findings.claim: Candidate nested-spawn accounting now separates reservation from measured or unknown use for covered flows.
findings.reproduction: Baseline suite failed 10/27 after overlaying only regression tests/helper/migration; candidate suites passed 27/27.
findings.impact: Avoids treating grants as measured consumption and makes admission/replay safer in tested local SQLite cases.
findings.resolution: Candidate commit e7baf39fdca9c7602cbf3644e7ffb11cc448c473; provider usage and hard in-call budget enforcement remain unproven.

findings.claim: ToolBroker does not mediate tool calls executed internally by external CLI runtimes, and enforcement differs by executor.

findings.impact: Prompt restrictions alone do not establish shell/filesystem/network isolation for CLI internals.
findings.resolution: Protected runtime-admission paths were not changed; propose executor-by-executor boundary verification before broader autonomy.
findings.verification: S11 NOT_TESTED; no sandbox boundary test executed.

findings.impact: Reuse or uplift claims cannot be made.
findings.resolution: Separate delivery/load/effect receipts under existing policy; run a controlled, authorized task later.

findings.claim: This session has no measured value/cost cohort that can establish net value from discovery or recurring loops.

supplemental_findings.claim: Two ACE-001 tests assumed the wall clock was before the registered readout deadline; after 2026-11-15T00:00:00Z they failed although the implementation correctly evaluated the deadline condition.
supplemental_findings.reproduction: Full PR CI at head b11b716c failed two assertions in ace-001.test.ts. The same two assertions failed locally on both candidate and origin/main 7758d153. The test passed a default now=Date.now() after ACE_001_STOP_BY.
supplemental_findings.change: Pin the two pre-readout assertions to Date.parse(ACE_001_STOP_BY)-1. Production/evaluation code and experiment protocol are unchanged.
supplemental_findings.verification: After test-only correction, focused ace-001 plus nested-spawn suites passed 53/53; server tsc passed; workspace lint passed with one pre-existing unused eslint-disable warning.
supplemental_findings.limitation: The full CI suite has not yet rerun on the corrected PR head; no holdout or experiment was opened.

supplemental_findings.claim: The full CI test suite has a time-dependent WEB-001 route fixture failure on the frozen baseline and candidate.
source: CI run 43707335553 at exact candidate head 8c3476471a1223df42e494bdbe84064ab6d18b72
supplemental_findings.reproduction: Run `npm run test -w @djimitflo/server -- web-research.test.ts` at candidate 8c3476471a1223df42e494bdbe84064ab6d18b72 and detached baseline 7758d153e415177de8e977721011c9675482934c. Both report 1 failed and 10 passed at line 250: the route receives null instead of a claimed job. The fixture inserts failures around 2026-11-08T06:00Z; the route uses current time and researchQuestions selects a seven-day window, so at 2026-11-15 12:20Z its evidence has aged out.
supplemental_findings.impact: Before the fixture correction, full repository CI was red on this unrelated WEB-001 route test, blocking full-suite validation of the PR head.
supplemental_findings.resolution: Test-only correction committed as d099810991945a64b3ec6bbad76ef2070082609e: route test freezes Date at the existing fixture NOW and restores real timers after each test. No WEB-001 product code changed.
supplemental_findings.verification: Original fixture reproduced red on baseline and pre-fix candidate (1 failed, 10 passed); corrected fixture passes 11/11 on the candidate and on the baseline with only the corrected test file overlaid. Full local repository test command, type-check, build, poller tests and audit:ci pass; lint has one pre-existing warning. Hosted CI run 43779085303 passed every job, including Node 22/24 tests and the security scan, at exact head ff16c2a5c403c6216c771a49158a2a78add423c3.
